## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — REQ-5, AC-2, AC-4, AC-5 + decomposition PR 4.

## Surface
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/classifier/circuit.rs` — circuit breaker state machine per classifier.
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/classifier/budget.rs` — per-classifier `tokio::sync::Semaphore`.
- New migration: `classifier_health` table
  ```
  classifier_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY
  state TEXT  -- 'closed' | 'open' | 'half_open'
  consecutive_failures INTEGER
  last_failure_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  last_probe_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  ```
- Extend `fanout.rs` to consult the circuit breaker before each call.

## Circuit-breaker state machine
States: `Closed` (calls allowed), `Open` (calls short-circuited, no attempts), `HalfOpen` (single probe call allowed).

Transitions:
- `Closed → Open`: 10 consecutive timeouts/errors (AC-5)
- `Open → HalfOpen`: 60s elapsed since open (AC-5)
- `HalfOpen → Closed`: probe succeeded; reset failure counter
- `HalfOpen → Open`: probe failed; restart 60s cooldown

## Rust-quality notes
- **Encode state as typestate** per rust-quality §2: `Circuit<Closed>`, `Circuit<Open>`, `Circuit<HalfOpen>`. Compile-time impossible to call `dispatch()` on `Circuit<Open>` (returns `CircuitOpen` error instead).
  - Pragmatic fallback: a runtime enum with exhaustive matches at every transition.
- **`tokio::sync::Semaphore`** is the bounded-concurrency primitive. Acquire is `await`-able; failure to acquire within timeout = treated as `RateLimited` error.
- **`tokio::time::timeout`** wraps the inner gRPC call. The classifier-config per-call timeout (default 500ms) is honored here, not inside the trait.
- **State persistence**: circuit-breaker state lives in memory (`Arc<RwLock<HashMap<String, CircuitState>>>`) AND is periodically flushed to `classifier_health` for operator visibility. Per rust-quality §10: no `RwLock` write guard held across `.await` — clone-and-release.
- **Per rust-quality §7**: property test on the state machine using `proptest`. Generate random sequences of `succeed` / `fail` / `tick(seconds)`, assert no impossible state sequences ever occur.
- **Tests for AC-4 (timeout cut-off)** use `tokio::time::pause()` + `tokio::time::advance()` for deterministic timing — don't rely on real `sleep` in tests (per rust-quality §10 / async-discipline).

## External references
- `tokio::sync::Semaphore`: https://docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/sync/struct.Semaphore.html
- `tokio::time::pause`: https://docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/time/fn.pause.html
- `failsafe-rs` (reference impl for circuit breakers): https://docs.rs/failsafe/latest/failsafe/
- typestate pattern: https://www.lurklurk.org/effective-rust/typestate.html

## Acceptance (AC-4, AC-5)
- [ ] AC-4: fixture classifier with `sleep(600ms)` is cut off at 500ms; ingest proceeds without this classifier's signal.
- [ ] AC-5: 10 consecutive failures → circuit opens for 60s → first call after 60s is the probe; success closes; failure restarts cooldown.
- [ ] AC-2 (closure): classifier-down stays non-blocking through every PR step.
